objective: Prepare (do not publish) System Admin music upload/delete and auto-playing photo ambience post-creative enhancements in consolidated BUKLOD Main V28 runtime 1.3.2.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-08 consolidated production 9a560caaec9befc0d54c70be36eaca619d587797 verified Android OTA 01a1b786-efd5-7076-a7c4-00c1498705b9 and web buklod.expo.app; crash hotfix is already in main.
chosenApproach: Extend existing private buklod-music-library storage and active metadata table with System Admin-gated CRUD using server RLS; use no new native modules; extend post-creative CHECK/preset map with lightweight visible-only auto ambiance overlay and keep lazy native audio on Play.
selectionRationale: Preserves 42 existing live songs and all existing post/media/ads. Avoids duplicating music storage, stale read cache, frontend-only authorization, eager native audio and heavy video effects.

Generate animated MP4 for every photo (rejected; high CPU/storage)
Publish before migration and CI (rejected; user explicitly forbids)
